data.answer: Production data is deleted by dropping the customer's tenant schema and the associated storage objects, while encrypted volumes are retired by deleting their encryption keys. After a contract ends and the 90-day export window closes, data is deleted from production systems within 30 days, and backups expire on their normal 35-day cycle so the last copy is gone no later than 35 days after production deletion.
For a Level P1 severity incident, which means customer data exposed or a full outage, the response time is to acknowledge within 15 minutes.
The founder is the only person who can place or release a legal hold.

A company laptop is issued to staff with mobile device management (MDM) installed and disk encryption enforced, but the provided text does not explicitly state whether staff access policyholder data from personal laptops or phones.

When a breach involving customer data is confirmed, affected customers are notified within 72 hours. Additionally, Nimbus Labs reports to CERT-In within 6 hours of becoming aware of a reportable cyber incident.
New hires must complete security awareness training within 7 days of joining.

The Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is 1 hour, meaning at most one hour of data can be lost. The Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is 4 hours, meaning service is restored within four hours of a declared disaster.
Shared secrets that the person had access to are rotated within 2 business days.
Nimbus Labs holds a SOC 2 Type II report and does not mention holding ISO 22301 business continuity certification (it notes it does not yet hold ISO 27001 certification).
